Binary

The zip contains the executables, generated HTML documentation, LICENSE, and
README.txt. The release has no library source archive and no build script.
The FFmpeg commit link does not include the statically linked libraries or
the scripts used to compile them.

Please provide, for this SHA256:

1. Complete source for FFmpeg commit b08d7969c5 as you compiled it, including
   any patch that is not in that commit.
2. Complete source for every statically linked library at the revision you
   compiled, including x264. The README says "x264 v0.164.3192" and does not
   give a commit id. Please name the exact commit or tarball and include any
   patch.
3. The same for the other libraries in that README's version list, and for
   bzlib, fontconfig, gmp, gnutls, iconv, libxml2, lzma, and zlib.
4. The build scripts, media-autobuild_suite revision, ini, per-library
   configure lines, nasm version, and the MSYS2 package versions used with
   gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project).
5. Any build log that shows those inputs produced this executable.

A link to current media-autobuild_suite master, or to the FFmpeg commit
alone, does not identify this binary. I will not treat this request as
permission to redistribute until you send the material above or say that
you do not have it.

Thank you.
